title: change-lane triage config (docs/domain/triage.json)
description: Optional. Every key falls back to the default in lib/triage.py DEFAULT_CONFIG. List values replace the default, except ignore_tokens, which extends it. Globs: `**` spans directories, `*` and `?` stay within one path segment; paths are repo-relative.

tweak_paths.description: Paths whose changes are TWEAK on their own and are not scanned for domain tokens or boundary imports. Default: styles (css/scss/sass/less), markdown, docs/**, i18n/locales, *.po, tests and *.test.* / *.spec.*.

layer_paths.description: Layer name -> globs, e.g. {"domain": ["src/domain/**"], "application": ["src/app/**"]}. A path covered here is mapped (eligible for TWEAK) even if the verification-policy classifier would call it shared or unmapped. Default: {}.

adapter_paths.description: Where boundary imports belong. A boundary import elsewhere is BOUNDARY_LEAK; inside, for a class not PRESENT in the baseline manifest, NEW_BOUNDARY. Default: **/adapters/**, **/adapter/**, **/infrastructure/**, **/infra/**.

boundary_import_patterns.description: Regexes matched against added lines, each naming the boundary class it opens (Stage 1 class names, e.g. NETWORK_API, DATASTORE, MESSAGE_TRANSPORT). Default covers common python and JS HTTP, database, queue and AWS clients.

ignore_tokens.description: UPPER_SNAKE values that are never domain tokens (added to the defaults: HTTP methods, JSON, UUID, log levels, ...).
